# Social Links

`content/social-links` &middot; content-level &middot; category: content

## Purpose

A row of social network links, as icons or as text links.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `links` | socialLinks |  |

## Optional fields

None.

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Icon row.
- **round**: Round icons. Sets `radius: 50%`.
- **text**: Plain text links separated by dots. Sets `display: text`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `display` | one of `icons`, `text` | `"icons"` |
| `align` | alignment | `"center"` |
| `iconSize` | length | `"32px"` |
| `radius` | length | `"@radius.small"` |
| `gap` | length | `"@spacing.xs"` |
| `color` | color | `"@colors.link"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"@spacing.sm 0"` |
| `darkMode` | boolean | `true` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Icons render as linked images, radius ignored. | Fine. The label is the alt text when images are blocked. | Icons keep their colors. Text variant follows the link color. |



## Example usage

This is a content-level component: it goes inside a column, so put it in the `content` of a `layout/section` (or another layout).

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('content/social-links', {
  "links": [
    {
      "network": "instagram",
      "href": "https://instagram.com/example",
      "label": "Instagram"
    },
    {
      "network": "facebook",
      "href": "https://facebook.com/example",
      "label": "Facebook"
    },
    {
      "network": "youtube",
      "href": "https://youtube.com/@example",
      "label": "YouTube"
    },
    {
      "network": "pinterest",
      "href": "https://pinterest.com/example",
      "label": "Pinterest"
    }
  ]
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):
